}

// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A typed function per route of each HTTP server, sending its arguments and
// decoding its result as the servers' JSON. Framework-neutral: hooks.ts adds
// React on top.

import type * as $t from "./types";

// [react]'s api_base, which each route's path goes after.
export const $base = "";

/** Runs proc P: `POST /api/p` on http server web-api. */
export async function p(_args: Record<string, never> = {}, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<number> {
  const v = await $call("POST", "/api/p", {
  }, opts);
  return $decInt(v, "result");
}

export function $enc_PArgs(_x: $t.PArgs): unknown {
  return {
  };
}

export function $dec_PArgs(v: unknown, at: string): $t.PArgs {
  $object(v, at);
  return {
  };
}

export function $enc_PSOut(x: $t.PSOut): unknown {
  return {
    "a": $encBool(x.a),
    "b": $enc_PSOutB(x.b),
  };
}

export function $dec_PSOut(v: unknown, at: string): $t.PSOut {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    a: $decBool($field(o, "a", at), at + ".a"),
    b: $dec_PSOutB($field(o, "b", at), at + ".b"),
  };
}

export function $enc_PSOutB(x: $t.PSOutB): unknown {
  if (x.tag === "X") return "X";
  if (x.tag === "Y") return { "Y": $encInt(x.value) };
  return $notA(x, "PSOutB");
}

export function $dec_PSOutB(v: unknown, at: string): $t.PSOutB {
  const [tag, p] = $variant(v, at);
  if (tag === "X" && p === $bare) return { tag: "X" };
  if (tag === "Y" && p !== $bare) return { tag: "Y", value: $decInt(p, at + ".Y") };
  return $noVariant(v, at, "PSOutB");
}

==== hooks.ts
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A React hook per route of each HTTP server, over client.ts: each gives the

// calls that are no longer wanted.

import * as React from "react";
import * as $c from "./client";

/**
 * Runs proc P through p (`POST /api/p` on http server web-api): with args,
 * whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useP(args?: Record<string, never> | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<Record<string, never>, number> {
  return $useCall($c.p, args, opts);
}
